Debloat.Title: 📦 WINDOWS UWP DEBLOAT MANAGER
Debloat.Description: Remove bloatware, telemetry, and promotional items (Windows 11 24H2/25H2)
Debloat.ConfirmBatch: Remove {0} selected packages? This cannot be undone without the Store.
Debloat.BatchRemoving: Batch removing {0} packages in a single PowerShell script...

Desc.uwp_copilot: Copilot AI, Bing side panels, and integrated web search.
Desc.uwp_webexp: Background web engine for Windows 11 taskbar widgets. Risk: medium.
Desc.uwp_clipchamp: Cloud video editor with built-in paid subscriptions.
Desc.uwp_newoutlook: Web-based Outlook running on Edge WebView with ads.
Desc.uwp_devhome: Developer dashboard installed by default on Windows 11.
Desc.uwp_news: Background MSN news feed on the taskbar and in widgets.
Desc.uwp_weather: MSN weather forecast with background geolocation sync.
Desc.uwp_sports: MSN sports news and match results.
Desc.uwp_todos: Microsoft To Do task lists with background sync.
Desc.uwp_stickynotes: Sticky Notes UWP notes on the desktop.
Desc.uwp_officehub: Promo hub for the Microsoft 365 / Office subscription.
Desc.uwp_gethelp: Built-in online help and Microsoft support bot.
Desc.uwp_feedback: Service collecting diagnostics, reports, and user surveys.
Desc.uwp_phonelink: Background sync of messages, calls, and photos (Phone Link).
Desc.uwp_people: Built-in address book and contact sync.
Desc.uwp_maps: Microsoft offline maps and navigation service.
Desc.uwp_bingsearch: Background Bing web search integrated into Start and Explorer.
Desc.uwp_solitaire: Solitaire collection with ads and Xbox Live notifications.
Desc.uwp_zunevideo: Default video player and movie rental store (Zune Video).
Desc.uwp_alarms: Windows Clock, alarms, timers, and stopwatch.
Desc.uwp_mixedreality: Environment and background service for VR/MR headsets.
Desc.uwp_photos: Default photo viewer. Optional — remove with care.
Desc.uwp_paint: Classic Paint packaged as UWP. Optional — remove with care.
Desc.uwp_xboxapp: Xbox client for installing and launching games.
Desc.uwp_xboxgamebar: Game Bar overlay with screen recording and Xbox background services.
Desc.uwp_xboxoverlay: Separate Xbox achievements overlay above games.
Desc.uwp_skype: Built-in UWP video calling and chat app.
Desc.uwp_mailcalendar: Classic Windows Mail and Calendar clients.
Desc.uwp_promostubs: Automatically installed promo shortcuts for third-party services. Risk: medium.
Desc.uwp_family: Microsoft Family (parental controls) app for Windows 11 24H2.
Desc.uwp_crossdevice: Background cross-device synchronization (Cross Device Experience). Risk: medium.
Desc.uwp_onedrive: Windows cloud sync. Removing it stops processes, uninstalls the app, and removes the Explorer icon.
